accuracy_notes: Groundwater, drinking-water and noise design records were retained as coverage gaps and not interpreted as absence of constraints.
Gas-pipeline, nuclear and HSE consultation narratives were not converted into parcel safety conclusions without current authoritative geometries and proposal-specific consultation evidence.
National Grid overhead-line, tower and substation surfaces were not used for commercial parcel scoring because the identified information was restrictive, non-commercial and indicative.
DNO regional licence areas were not treated as connection headroom, reinforcement cost or development-capacity evidence.
Ecology backlog and research surfaces were not interpreted as absence of habitats, protected species or nutrient constraints.
SAC, SPA, Ramsar and national-nature-reserve examples were not promoted without exact canonical parcel or proposal intersections and project-specific impact-pathway assessment.
No parcel relation, future-growth score or business row was fabricated.
